prompt_markdown: In what order does the data move through the app?
hint: Start at the file you run, and follow the value through each step to where it is saved.

material: intake.py      cleans and checks typed input
store.py       saves and loads family records
settings.py    values that change between pantries

options.text: All four files run at the same time

why: The entry point takes the typed text, it is cleaned and checked, the parcels are decided, and then the record is saved.
